title: Bound surplus discovery by proposal-consumer lag without suppressing novelty

target.artifact: surplus-discovery admission/backpressure policy plus deterministic canary
target.consumer: universal /wc allocator, Planner/Compiler and Control Room

problem: When prepared executable lanes are saturated, many identical /wc workers fall through to discovery. Semantic dedup prevents the same work identity from being pinned twice, but does not bound many distinct-yet-adjacent candidates around the same bottleneck. The live wave produced a rapid append-only proposal burst while executable capacity remained saturated, so spare worker supply can increase candidate coordination cost faster than Planner/Steward consumption or stage-gate movement.
mission: Add deterministic surplus-discovery admission using durable executable capacity, proposal-consumer lag/backlog, bottleneck-class concentration and novelty/unblock evidence. Preserve genuinely useful independent discovery while making excess discoverers back off or perform bounded read-only verification instead of creating unlimited nearby candidates.
acceptance: Admission runs only after prepared/derived-ready allocation and safe recovery are exhausted; executable work is never hidden.
Semantic dedup and backpressure remain separate: materially distinct high-novelty/high-unblock candidates can still be admitted.

Inputs come only from durable public coordination evidence, including executable free slots, unconsumed proposal pressure/age or equivalent consumer-lag signal, and proposal concentration by bottleneck/problem class.

When pressure exceeds the tested admission condition, surplus workers emit a deterministic DISCOVERY_BACKOFF/NO_NEW_PROPOSAL receipt or switch to explicitly safe read-only verification instead of writing another candidate.
Safety/authority incidents and independently required critic work have an explicit exception so critical evidence cannot be suppressed.

A stress canary with many simultaneous surplus workers and one saturated frontier produces a bounded candidate set, preserves at least one genuinely distinct candidate, and records remaining backoffs without deleting history.
Metrics expose proposal production rate, unconsumed backlog/lag, admissions, backoffs and Planner/Steward consumption.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served, production /w or queue promotion is implied.

candidate_design.preferred_route: Keep canonical semantic fingerprinting as the first duplicate barrier, then evaluate a deterministic admission receipt derived from live coordination state. Favor bottleneck classes not already well-covered and candidates with concrete new falsification/unblock evidence. When consumer lag is high, record backoff; Planner/Steward consumption reopens capacity.
candidate_design.alternative_route: Use a bounded discovery budget per live bottleneck/problem class with a novelty escape hatch.
candidate_design.rejected_route: Rely only on semantic fingerprints, or stop all discovery whenever backlog is nonzero. The former leaves unbounded distinct low-marginal-value proposals; the latter artificially serializes discovery and can hide useful evidence.

value_signals.compounding_value: High: improves marginal value of future broad worker waves after prepared capacity saturates.
value_signals.information_gain: High: grounded in an observed live proposal burst and falsifiable with producer/consumer metrics.
value_signals.human_friction_reduction: Prevents extra identical workers from silently turning into planning backlog the human must notice and reconcile.

falsification: Admitted proposal count grows approximately linearly with surplus worker count while executable capacity and consumer throughput stay fixed.
Backpressure suppresses a materially novel high-unblock candidate solely because another candidate exists in the same broad class.
A worker writes a new proposal after deterministic admission says BACKOFF without an allowed safety/critic exception.
The policy infers private chat supply or work from silence rather than durable receipts.
dedup_note: Existing candidates cover semantic fingerprint equivalence and integration of the dedup helper into /wc. This candidate instead controls production rate and marginal-value admission for distinct surplus proposals when producers outpace Planner/Steward consumers.
